title: Cockroaches Cathisteria
subtitle: Fed, her cats, and the end of the world in the basement
acknowledgements: A Doom-inspired game written from scratch: no names, art, sounds or levels from commercial games.
The 8x8 font is the PRG32 firmware font.
The soundtrack is an original 12-bar Chicago blues: no existing songs are quoted.

controls.action: Send a cat at the enemy in the crosshair (hold to repeat)

start_prompt: Press A to send the cats
